opinions.snippet:
MORRIS, Judge.
John Casteel appeals an order granting relief from judgment. The underlying negligence action arose out of a car accident involving Casteel and Anna Mad-dalena. A bifurcated trial1 was held, and the jury determined that Casteel was 55% hable while Maddalena was 45% liable.
